monsterTypes.text: YOU FOUND ME! CAN YOU BEAT ME?
LOOK OUT! THIS ONE IS FAST!
RUN AWAY! THIS ONE IS NASTY!

intro: You've reached the Gargonian portion of
this dungeon... This area is dominated
by tough, evil, part human, part beast
monsters which will try to defeat you!
descriptions: SHADOW GARGALON: She is the leader of
Section I. She commands all other
local inhabitants, and will be a worthy
opponent if you succeed in finding her.
GARGALON:  Part human, part snake and
all evil this creature lives in dark
corners of the dungeoun awaits for
its prey. Related to the Harpey.
LESDIDIAN WARRIOR: This ferocious woman
comes from a race of all women warriors
that live in the dungeoun.  She is a
quick, agile, and deadly opponent.
HARPEY: This psychotic creature hails
from an ancient race of a magical
inbreed of human-bird-animal. Harpeys
are often found near Lesdidians.
SUSTRONTIMA: This nasty person thrives
on other creature's life force. Come to
think of it, your life force will do
very nicely!

intro: You are entering Elemental Section. The
monsters in this area are related to
the old planet Eart. They were born
from the Eart, wind, water and fire.
descriptions: SHADOW ELEMENTAL: This is the leader of
the Elementals. This nasty creature is
capable of defeating even the most
powerful adventurers, so be careful!
FIRE ELEMENTAL: This flaming monster
emits so much heat it is hard to get
NEAR it! Its flaming sword is very
harmful to humanoids like yourself.
STONE ELEMENTAL: This creature is slow
and overbearing, and its blows are
extremely powerful. It is at home in
stone corridors and rooms.
WIND ELEMENTAL: It is believed that
this creature evolved from a thing
called a 'storm' from the old planet
Eart. No one knows how it got here.
WATER ELEMENTAL: Quite simply, your
worst nightmare.  This evil being is
strong, powerful, intelligent and worst
worst of all, already dead. Good luck.

intro: Welcome to Section III of Dungeons of
the Unforgiven! This area is inhabited
by evil flying creatures which hope to
carve you up and dispose of you!
descriptions: SHADOW VULTURE: The leader of the
flying creatures, this evil beast uses
it's magical powers to control it's
followers.
VULTURE OF DEATH: This is a skillful
fighter, who will fly around at high
speed, hacking away at its enemies. It
is often found near Were Rat-Bats.
FLYING SPECTRA: These monsters gain
their magical flying abilities by the
grace of the Shadow Vulture. This helps
create loyalty in this Section.
STRIKER: This monster is called a
Striker because of it's highly accurate
striking ability. You should try not to
let it get it's claws into you!
WERE RAT-BAT: This undead bird will
make your skin crawl just by its mere
presence. When it is near, the temp-
erature seems to drop about 20 degrees!

intro: Section IV was flooded many ages ago.
Since that time, creatures have evolved
to thrive in the watery corridors. Be
ready to do some wading and swimming!
descriptions: SHADOW DEMON QUEEN: This unfriendly
character's four hands would each like
to remove one of your limbs at the same
time. Don't let her.
SHE-DEMON: These creatures are servants
of the Shadow She-Demon. They serve her
by providing the bodies of foolish
adventurers. They do their job well!
WATERY GRAVERD: When the rivers got
really mad at the pollution back on
Eart, this creature evolved directly
from the water to protect the rivers.
COUPLE FROM HELL: This fine married
couple are generally found drifting in
a small wooden boat. They are friends
with little birds. They don't like you.
WATER TROGLADYTE: Yet another water
loving creature, this one can breath
both air and water! Also watch out for
it's very sharp axe. Eats life too.

intro: Section V is controlled by lizard-like
people who once were peace-loving nice
folks, just enjoying civilization. Then
they met the Eartlings.
descriptions: SHADOW TROGGISHER: This is the leader
of the evil lizard creatures. All
lizardoids are totally loyal to it, and
will give their lives happily for it.
TROGGISHER: This overgrown lizard loves
the taste of flesh and will go through
your armor to get it. It is very quick
with its weapon.
TORMAN: This critter was cross-bred by
an evil scientist who wanted to know
what a part-human, part-lizard, part
turtle would look like! Now we know!
DOZARD: This almost humanoid lizard is
feared far and wide. It has great
strength, and very think skin. It is
very loyal to the Shadow Troggisher.
CRORDER: This is possibly the wierdest
creature of all. The Crorder (Crab-
Horse-Spider) proves that everything
is just a bit strange in the dungeoun.

intro: Section VI is littered with squishy and
slimy critters, who often slurp up nice
people like you! Note the body parts
protruding from their squishy figures.
descriptions: SHADOW GIANT WORM: Worms aren't fish-
bait any more! Now they have their own
sovereign territory, and the shadow
giant worm is their leader!
GIANT WORM: These monsters are always
looking for small creatures to use as
bait. Your lifeless body will serve
that need perfectly.
OOZING BLOB: Blobs form from the slime
and gunk of the dungeon walls. Although
they move very slowly, you could become
part of the blob should it catch you.
SQUISHY CUBE: There are not yet enough
creatures stuck in this monsters oozing
jello-like cubes. All it needs is one
more just like you!
SHAPE SHIFTER: This guy rises from the
floor and attacks all foreigners. The
dungeon walls then absorb his victim's
life force.

intro: Section VII is populated by huge insect
creatures from planet Eart. As hard as
the Humanoids tried to destroy all the
insects, now they have their own land!
descriptions: SHADOW SCORPIAN: The great leader of
the insects communicates telepathically
with all of the other insects in her
section. Watch out for her tail.
SCORPIAN: All of the black scorpians
are children of the Shadow Scorpian.
They will do anything to portect their
mother.
GIANT SPIDER: The Giant Black Spiders
are good friends with the Scorpians,
who liberated them during the Race-Wars
of the past.
GIANT RAT: Giant Rats were created by
mistake by a cosmetology company. The
Rats declared war on the humans,
confusing animal rights groups.
GIANT BAT: These were the first bats to
adapt to space. They were actually able
to fly between colonies using lifeforce
as propulsion. Thus they drain levels.

intro: Section VIII is another flooded section
of the dungoen. It's inabitants have
learned to use the water to its fullest
potential.
descriptions: SHADOW SKEETER: And you thought only
the Messiah could walk on water! This
creature is no Messiah (don't tell him
that), but he is quite powerful.
WATER SKEETER: Each of these monsters
wants to become the Shadow Skeeter.
The one who kills the most adventurers
will have that honor.
HYDRA: This fire-breathing monster will
burn you if you let it. It is close
friends with the Water Dragons who
breathe ice.
WATER DRAGON: This sly monster quietly
drifts through the water in search of
warm blooded victims like you! It likes
to breathe ice storms onto its ememies.
ANIMATED WATERLING: This monster's evil
weapon thrives on draining the life
from its enemies. If it hits you, it
will drain some of yours.

intro: Section IX is populated by strong body-
builder types, who tend to look alike.
They are all searching for a head for
their leader. Hmm, what about yours?
descriptions: SHADOW HEAD HUNTER: Ever think you
might lose your head? This fellow did!
Don't let that mislead you, however, he
is still a very tough monster!
HEAD HUNTER: These followers of the
Shadow Head Hunter all cut off their
own heads in order to be accepted by
their leader!
POGERSTEAD: These monsters were not
quite brave enough to cut off their own
heads like the Head Hunters, but they
still serve their leader's cause.
GROBLER: Groblers are distant relatives
of the Pogersteads. They also serve the
Shadow Head Hunter, but not by choice.
They are killed when they disobey.
WRAITH: Wraiths are dead adventurers
who were killed by the Head Hunters.
They still wander the halls of this
section in search of a life.

intro: Section X is populated by more psuedo-
hunamoid mutants. They are purely evil,
and they are always looking for more
adventurers to kill.
descriptions: SHADOW KHAGISTOLL: These folks took the
saying 'Two heads are better than one'
to its extreme as they have two bodies!
They work together well.
KHAGISTOLL: These followers of the
Shadow Khagistoll, are able to attack
you with four weapons at once! Running
away is highly recommended!
FLAMING IDIOT: While this monster can
attack you with its arms, it can also
lean forward and spurt flames at you!
Be prepared to be cooked.
TRIOP: These guys also took the 'Two
heads are better than one' saying to
heart. They have three heads! Note that
the middle one makes most decisions.
MUMMY: The inhabitants of this section
sometimes go to cemetaries and unearth
dead humanoids and wrap them up and
bring them back to life.

intro: Section XI is ruled by strange critters
like Eyeballs, Flesh Eaters, and
others. These strange critters can not
be trusted. Do not be their friend!
descriptions: SHADOW EYEBALL: Try not to look at this
fellow any more than necessary. The
Shadow Eyeball is very shy and tends to
attack anyone it catches staring!
EYEBALL: These are the children of the
Shadow Eyeball. If they see you, you
can assume that the Shadow Eyeball sees
you too.
FLESH EATER: Flesh is the only food for
this hungry monster. This adds a new
and special meaning to the words,
'Don't feed the animals'!
FOOT STOMPER: Ever wonder what an ant
feels like when you crush it under your
heel? This monster will help you to
know exactly how that feels!
FACE OF DEATH: Death is a hobby for
this nice-looking monster. Your death
is a particular focus of its hobby.
Everyone has to have a hobby.

intro: Section XII is awash in filthy slimy
sludge water. The inhabitants love to
drink it! They gain their evil power
from this special sludge.
descriptions: SHADOW MR. FANG: This evil leader
controls all of the Vampires, Orcs,
and Gargoyals. It is a very dangerous
monster, and is very hard to kill.
MR. FANG: The Shadow Mr. Fang learned
to clone itself, and these critters are
the result. They all think alike, but
are less powerful than their creator.
ORC: Cross-breeding experiments between
humans and pigs created this monster.
At first, the scientists tried to kill
them all, but they failed.
GARGOYLE: A student of the occult found
out that the statues at the entrances
of buildings could be animated. Now
they breed like rabbits!
VAMPIRE: These once proud but secret
members of the Human Race are now the
slaves of the Shadow Blood Sucker. They
still drink blood and life for food!

intro: Section XIII is run by armored warriors
and other human-like creatures. Don't
let that deceive you though, they would
knock off your head with no regrets!
descriptions: SHADOW WARRIOR: This tough monster is
protected by invisible armor, which
makes it extremely hard to hit. Spells
are highly recommended.
ARMORED WARRIOR: Plates of white steel
guard this warrior's body. If you plan
to attack it, be prepared for a very
tough battle to get through the armor.
VERY MEAN HUMAN: This friendly-looking
creature is only interested in killing
its enemies. These monsters have no
friends.
DWARF: Don't let this little guy's
height deceive you! He can fight just
as well as the next guy. Or girl. Or
it.
ZOMBIE: These undead creatures are
dangerous, even if they are missing a
few pieces of their bodies. The pieces
that are left still work fine.

intro: Section XIV is a veritable zoo! Apes,
Werewolves, and Unicorns wander about
in search of food! There are signs
everywhere that say 'feed the animals'!
descriptions: SHADOW APE-MAN: Just think of this one
as the leader of the 'Section of the
Apes'. The Shadow Ape-Man is followed
by various animal-types.
APE-MAN: Humans once thought the Ape-
Man was an inferior creature. The Ape-
Men tought the Humans a lesson in the
Battle of the Moon.
WEREWOLF: This powerful enemy is a good
monster to run away from. It has
powerful attacks, fast strikes, and
tough armor!
UNICORN: Have you ever eaten a shish-
kabob. Try to picture yourself with
that horn poking through your body and
you will see your future!
DEMON: This good friend of the devil
been sent to the land of the living to
bring back souls. If it hits you, you
will lose a level and some strength.

intro: Section XV is stuffed with dragons of
various sorts. Be prepared to be burned
by fire breathing monsters if you
adventure in this section.
descriptions: SHADOW DRAGON KING: The leader of the
dragons, the Shadow Dragon King has
evil powers, including its ability to
breathe fire.
DRAGON PRINCE: Like politicians, all of
the Dragon Princes aspire to be the
Dragon King. Watch out for their fangs
and their bad breathe.
DRAGON: All of the Dragons, of course,
aspire to become Dragon Princes (or
Princesses). They also breathe fire as
well as their conventional attack.
DRAGONFLY: Like the other inhabitants
of this section, the Dragonflies all
want to become Dragons. But don't
underestimate the Dragonflies!
CHIMERA: These evil creatures not only
drain life from their victims, they
also breathe fire. They learned this
trick from the Dragons.

intro: Section XVI is a sort of heaven in
which you feel very uncomfortable. The
demi-gods that live here just don't
seem to like you much!
descriptions: SHADOW EVIL GOD: This is the god of all
of the demi-gods. Don't let that scare
you though. The Shadow Evil God drains
strength and breathes ice.
ZEUS: Once upon a time Zues was a very
powerful god in his own right, but when
the Zues's multiplied, they lost their
power and now they follow the Evil God.
TROLL: Trolls are loyal followers of
the the Shadow Evil God. Their only
purpose in life is to destroy enemy
adventurers who threaten their God.
TITAN: Close friends with the other
residents of this section, Titans were
persuaded to turn evil by the Shadow
Evil God.
DEVIL: And you thought the devil was
the most evil creature in the universe.
Actually, there are numerous devils
who follow the Shadow Evil God.

intro: Section XVII is another section that is
overrun with mutant humanoids. If they
succeed in killing you, you can be sure
that you will be experimented on!
descriptions: SHADOW OGRE: The Shadow Ogre welcomes
you to Module V of the Dungeons of the
Unforgiven. Do not be deceived by this
friendly welcome, though.
OGRE: This powerful monster is very
difficult to kill. It has powerful
attacks, and tough skin as well. Be
ready for heavy battle with this one.
KOBALD: These are the little brothers
of the Ogres. You may find it possible
to dispence these creatures easily, but
do not expect the Orges to just sit by.
GOBLIN: Goblins are mischievous little
critters who are often found near the
Kobalds. Their friendship goes all the
way back to the Race-Wars.
GHOUL: The Ghouls gather life force for
all of the other folks in this section.
They drain your levels and pass them on
the Ogres, Kobalds, and Goblins.

intro: Section XVIII is a strange alliance of
creatures who hate everything. If you
can kill everything that lives here,
the universe will be a better place!
descriptions: SHADOW STONE GIANT: This horrible evil
monster is very strong, very powerful,
and it also drains levels! Don't let
this one hit you!
STONE GIANT: The Stone Giants broke
ranks with the Eart Elementals way back
during the ancient Race-Wars. Now the
Stone Giants have their own territory.
WALKING SWORD: Warriors have always
believed that swords had their own
personality. This one walks around and
attacks on its own, too!
PIT BULL: Taking a cue from the humans,
Pit Bulls killed off all other species
of dogs. They are extremely evil
creatures!
SKELETON: These are dead people who
never quite got properly buried. They
really want to be alive again, and they
are sure that draining you will help.

intro: Creepy clawly critters live in Section
XIX. Watch out for poison, which seems
to be everywhere! Casting a resist
poison might be a wise idea!
descriptions: SHADOW CENTIPEDE: Another leader of
an insect infested section, the Shadow
Centipede is a serious foe indeed! It
drains life among other powers.
CENTIPEDE: Oh boy! Another poisonous
monster! If this monster hits you, you
will have to deal with poison. Being
poisoned is an unpleasant experience.
GIANT ANT: These giant worker ants are
controlled not by a queen ant, but by
the Shadow Centipede. Try not to get in
their way.
GIANT TOAD: The Giant Toads are often
found near the Giant Ants and the
Centipedes. Watch out for the Giant
Toads' poison tongues.
SPECTER: Specters drain both levels and
strength. You must decide whether keys
and potions justify the losses these
monsters promise to inflict on you.

intro: Section XX is the deepest section of
Dungeons of the Unforgiven! Take this
piece of advice: Go home, stay there,
and never come back to this Section!
descriptions: SHADOW OGEROTH: This is the commander
of all of the Dungeons of the Unfor-
givin! It drains lots of things, so be
extremely careful!
OGEROTH: That gigantic fist is very,
very painful when it hits you! And at
that size, how can it miss? Be prepared
for some serious battle!
WATER RAT: You heard of rats in sewer
pipes, well, this is the sewer rat from
hell! These rats always carry diseases,
so don't let them hit you!
ELF SURFER: This fellow descended from
the beach bums from Eart. They can do
some amazing tricks with their surf-
boards!
ROTTING SWAMP PLANT: This evil plant
would like to invite you to rot with
it. If it hits you, you will lose two
levels, and some intelligence!
